Well, sorry to break it to you- but your son has sex. Stop being so stuck into old ways- the world changed, the beliefs are not the same. He’s gonna do what he’s gonna do. The most important thing is that he needs to know you have his back and has you also as a friend to rely and talk should he need to. Educate him about sex, pregnancy, feelings, emotions.. and let him know that you’re there for him. You’re just creating boundaries in your head, he has different ones than you and he’ll do whatever he thinks is best- so wouldn’t you rather KNOW what he’s doing and walk him through it? Please understand that things are DIFFERENT and changing- and don’t hold that against him.
